content.text: stimulates Ab prod to host tissues & damages organs directly
•follows untx or inadeq tx GAS pharyngitis
•the infect USU precedes the onset or rheumatic fever by 2-4wks
2 or more joints affected or migratory
•medium/lrg joints MC affected (knees · hips · wrists · elbows · shoulders)
heat, redness, swelling, & severe joint pain
•carditis = most serious manifestation - permanent valvular damage
•MV MC affected - MR = MC lesion: high-pitched blowing holosystol murmur @ apex → axilla
•Carey Coombs murmur: short mid-diastol murmur ← ↑flow across MV in mod-severe MR
•AR: high-pitched blowing early diastol murmur @ LSB - pt leaning forward
ddx AS: harsh crescendo-decrescendo SEM @ RUSB → carotids - ⍉characteristic of ARF
•sudden involuntary · jerky · ⍉rhythmic purposeless mvts esp. involving head/arms
- spread outward w distinct border & central clearing
•early Sx - may be one of last to resolve
•seen over joints (extensor surfaces) · scalp & spinal column
•Jaccoud arthropathy: rare late finding - painless loosening & lengthening of hand/ft joints
•carditis & prolonged PR count once · polyarthritis & arthralgia ⍉counted separately
supportive evidence of recent group A strep infect
•↑/↑ streptococcal Ab titers (ex, antideoxynuclease B or antistreptolysin O)
•echo in all sus ARF → clin or subclin carditis
•prev of recurr: PCN G benzathine IM q21-28d
•early ID of valvular dz · emotional support
•MS: late comp of RHD - low-pitched rumbling mid-diastol murmur @ apex ± opening snap (MR > MS)
